notes.title: Solar War design document now available
notes.content:
Here's a little easter present for all of you who still follow this game. I posted my original design document from before I actually started main development work online at http://solarwar.net/files/public/solarwar-designdoc.pdf

This contains a peek at a few ideas that did not make it into the game, more details on some that did, as well as yet unpublished background on lore elements of the world.

Mostly, I hope this might be helpful as a starting point for anyone who wants to build their own game, but it might also be of interest to anyone who just wants to look at how a game like this is made before programming comes into play.

If there is enough interest in this kind of thing, I might also publish some balancing spreadsheets I used in the design stage.

notes.title: Solar War 1.14b released
notes.content:
Just a tiny fix for a problem recently reported. Turns out the game wanted to look up keys in data that was not yet loaded at that time. Which is bad. I hope not too many of you actually ran into this.

[b]Bugfixes[/b][list][*]Fixed a crash when hitting keys on the "Loading" startup screen[/*]

notes.title: Solar War 1.12 released
notes.content:
Version 1.12 is a quality of life update focused on saving you a bunch of clicks and fussing about when managing your fleet. Most importantly, your subordinates will now highlight ships in need of your attention to you, so you will no longer have to dig through so many dull ship status reports. 

[b]Enhancements[/b][list][*]Added various ship status overviews to the navigator, defaulting to alert reports[/*][*]Fleet stats (warp capacity and fleet supply) are now shown in the navigator when a single unit is selected[/*][*]Module tech requirements are now listed in the Solarpedia[/*][/list][b]Bugfixes[/b][list][*]Fixed crash on selecting "(no character)" in character swap mode[/*][/list]

notes.title: Solar War 1.10 released
notes.content:
This is the first version of the game released on Steam. Another big Thank You to everyone who supported Solar War on Greenlight!

[b]Enhancements[/b][list][*]Steam achievement support added (Steam version only)[/*][*]The main officer list can now be sorted by promotion eligibility[/*][*]If the game crashes, it will now try to autosave before shutting down[/*][/list][b]Bugfixes[/b][list][*]Fixed a crash when selecting locations that were collapsed in the navigator[/*][*]Fixed a crash when dragging from an empty table in the Combat AI popup[/*][*]Disabled tutorial popups while autoresolving a battle[/*][/list]
